journeyIntro: Work in organic and hybrid devices led to molecular interfaces, defects, and charge transport; memory-device physics and process variability now connect those foundations to reliability questions. Oxide electronics and integration remain future directions.

trajectory.title: Integrated electronic systems
trajectory.detail: Low-temperature electronics · Heterogeneous integration · 3D integration · Device–system co-design

expertiseIntro: Methods documented in device and interface research.

expertise.title: Interface engineering
expertise.description: Hydrogen-bonded perovskite interfaces, self-assembled monolayer contacts, and ALD-grown thin films and electrodes.

expertise.title: Memory-device characterization
expertise.description: Analog conductance updates, trap-density analysis, retention, read noise, and switching variability.

expertise.title: Array-level evaluation
expertise.description: Fabricated crossbar characterization, image-classification evaluation, and PCB-integrated ADC/FPGA readout.

expertise.title: Flexible interconnect reliability
expertise.description: Printed-film thickness, trace-to-trace electrical variation, and resistance changes under deformation.

independence: Principal Investigator, Doctoral Research Support Program · Ministry of Education · since September 2026
